title: 風のなか
grammarPatterns: V-て V (sequential action — きて、みて)
V-て + ください / V-て
V-ている (ongoing state, recycled from ch11)

plotSummary: A windy day on the hill above the valley. Sniff arrives; Moomintroll waves him over; something flies past overhead. They chain small actions together: come here, look at my hand, see the flying thing, climb down. The て-form of the verb takes its foregrounding chapter here — V-て + clause. The kiss of the chapter is Moomintroll reaching out and drawing Sniff into the scene.

scene.beat: The hill. Wind. A flying creature passes. V-て-sequencing strings small actions together.

continuity.to: ch17 (the clearing — big voices, small voices)

prose.speaker: ムーミン
prose.html: わあ、強い風だね！
prose.htmlFull: わあ、<ruby data-lemma="強い" data-surface="強い">強<rt>つよ</rt></ruby>い<ruby data-lemma="風" data-surface="風">風<rt>かぜ</rt></ruby>だね！

prose.html: スニフも、丘おかを登って来た。三人は、風の中に立っていた。

prose.text: え、あいつ？あいつは、だれ？

prose.text: 降りて来るといいな！こっちへ、降りて来て！

prose.text: うーん、でも、本当にこわくないの？

prose.text: ほら、スニフ、こっちだ！走って、走って！

prose.text: 丘を降りて、谷のほうへ走って行った。走って、走って、また走った。でも、風船は、空の遠くへ飛んで行って、もう見えなくなった。

prose.text: でも、楽しかったね。風の中を、いっぱい走った。

grammarNotes: V-て + V (sequential action) — the core of this chapter. おりてきて = "come down"; みて、いく = "look and go"; きて、みる = "come and look." The て-form connects two actions.
V-て as request — 降りて来て！ = "come down!"; よく見て = "look carefully". The bare て-form request is the everyday child register; てください (ch17) is its politer coat.
V-ている reappears from ch11 — とんでいる = "is flying"; 吹いていた = "was blowing." The て-form + いる; the progressive.

あいつ — rough "that one/that thing". Sniff's panic-word for the unknown shape in the sky. When the thing gets a name (風船), あいつ dissolves — naming things makes them smaller. That is the chapter's quiet lesson.
風が吹く — "the wind blows". The set collocation; the chapter is windy from first line to last.
